mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, name, employee_no, dept_id, position_id, user_id, employee_status, hire_date, resign_date, deleted FROM hr_employee WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, tenant_id, position_name, status, version FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{positionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, tenant_id, course_name, status, skill_id, target_level, version, deleted FROM hr_training_course WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_training_course SET skill_id = #{input.skillId}, target_level = #{input.targetLevel}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{courseId} AND version = #{input.version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE hr_position SET version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{positionId} AND version = #{version}

when.test: (scope.type == 1 or scope.type == 2) and scope.deptIds != null and !scope.deptIds.isEmpty()

mapper.select:
SELECT employee.id, employee.tenant_id, employee.name, employee.employee_no, employee.dept_id, employee.position_id, employee.user_id, employee.employee_status, employee.hire_date, employee.resign_date, employee.deleted FROM hr_employee employee WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND employee.employee_status IN ('ACTIVE','REGULAR','PROBATION','INTERN','ON_LEAVE','TRANSFERRED') AND employee.hire_date <= #{today} AND (employee.resign_date IS NULL OR employee.resign_date > #{today})
AND employee.id = #{query.employeeId} AND employee.position_id = #{query.positionId}
AND (employee.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR employee.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY employee.id

SELECT course.id AS courseId, course.course_name AS courseName, course.target_level AS targetLevel, session.id AS sessionId, session.session_no AS sessionNo FROM hr_training_course course JOIN hr_training_session session ON session.tenant_id = course.tenant_id AND session.course_id = course.id WHERE course.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND course.deleted = 0 AND course.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND course.skill_id = #{skillId} AND course.target_level >= #{requiredLevel} AND session.deleted = 0 AND session.status IN ('PLANNED','REGISTERING','ONGOING') AND session.end_time >= #{now} AND session.capacity > session.enrolled_count AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_training_enrollment enrollment WHERE enrollment.tenant_id = course.tenant_id AND enrollment.session_id = session.id AND enrollment.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND enrollment.deleted = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_employee employee JOIN sys_user account ON account.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND account.user_id = employee.user_id AND account.status = '0' AND account.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role user_role ON user_role.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND user_role.user_id = account.user_id JOIN sys_role role ON role.tenant_id = user_role.tenant_id AND role.role_id = user_role.role_id AND role.status = '0' AND role.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu role_menu ON role_menu.tenant_id = role.tenant_id AND role_menu.role_id = role.role_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = role_menu.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE employee.tenant_id = course.tenant_id AND employee.id = #{employeeId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND menu.perms = 'hr:training:enroll:add') ORDER BY course.target_level, course.id, session.start_time, session.id LIMIT 100
